plain.li: [agree,working] Right, I'd better finish this before the light goes.
[agree,eating] Pass the bread, and let's leave it on that.
[agree,evening] Good, I'll sleep better for hearing that.
[agree,outside,rain] Let's get out of this rain while we still agree.
[agree,cold] Glad we agree, now let's get somewhere warm.
[agree] I'll hold you to that the next time it comes up.
[debate,working] Hand me that, and you can tell me I'm wrong while we work.
[debate,eating] Finish eating, you'll argue better on a full stomach.
[debate,night] It's too late at night for me to win this.
[debate,morning] Too early for this, ask me after I've eaten.
[debate] Let's leave it there, before one of us says something clever.
[debate,old] I've had this argument for forty years and I'm not tired of it yet.
[argue,working] I've work to do, and so have you.
[argue,eating] I've lost my appetite, thanks.
[argue,night] I'm going to bed, and I hope you lie awake.
[argue] Next time, keep your opinions in your pocket.
[argue,hurt] I'm too sore for this, leave me be.

warm.li: [agree] Thank you, that's made my day easier.
[debate,eating] Let's eat, we can argue after.
[argue] Come and find me when you're ready to talk, I'll be about.

cheerful.li: [agree,eating] Let's drink to that, even if it's only water.
[debate,working] Whoever's wrong does the rest of this job.
[argue] I'm going to go and agree with someone nicer.

gloomy.li: [agree,night] At least we'll lie awake agreeing.
[debate] Nothing gets decided out here anyway.
[argue] Fine, I'll be wrong somewhere on my own.

plain.li: [agree,working] Yes, and you'll get no argument from me while my hands are full.
[agree,eating] Yes, and that's the truest thing said at this table.
[agree,old] I've seen enough years to know you're right.
[agree,newcomer] I'm new here, but I've seen the same.
[debate,working] Hold that end, and I'll tell you where you're wrong.
[debate,eating] Let me finish chewing and then I'll disagree.
[debate,night] It's late, but no, I don't think so.
[debate,child] That's not what the grown-ups said.
[debate,old] I thought that at your age too.
[debate,newcomer] Where I come from, we'd see it differently.
[argue,working] I've my hands full, and you want to fight?
[argue,eating] You're putting me off my food.
[argue,hurt] I'm in no state for this, and you're not helping.
[argue,night] It's the middle of the night, {OTHER}.
[argue,afterraid] After the days we've had, you start this?
[argue,teen] You always talk to me like I'm a child.

warm.li: [agree,eating] Yes, and have some more, you've hardly eaten.
[debate] I think you're wrong, but I'm glad you said it to me.
[argue,hurt] Please, not now, I'm hurting enough.

blunt.li: [argue,afterraid] Not now, not after all that.

cheerful.li: [agree,eating] Agreed, and I'm having your bread as a reward.
[debate,working] Wrong, but you work beautifully while you're being wrong.
[argue,rain] It's raining, I'm wet, and you're wrong.

gloomy.li: [agree,cold] Yes, and it's too cold to argue anyway.
[debate,night] Maybe, but everything looks worse at night.
[argue,afterraid] We nearly died, and this is what you want to talk about.

plain.li: [debate,working] Pass me that, and we'll call it a draw.
[debate,eating] Eat up, you'll need your strength to lose.
[debate,night] Goodnight, and you're still wrong.
[debate,morning] Ask me again when I'm awake.
[debate] I'll be thinking of an answer all through supper now.
[argue,working] I'll finish this on my own.
[argue,eating] Enjoy your meal, I'm done with mine.
[argue,night] Don't wake me when you come in.
[argue] Sit somewhere else at supper.
[argue,hurt] I've enough aches without you.
[reminisce,old] I was younger then, and so were you.
[reminisce,winter] It was cold like this, wasn't it.
[reminisce,night] I'll be thinking about that all night now.
[reminisce,afterraid] After the last few days, it's good to remember something else.
[tease] I'll pay you back, you'll see.
[comfort,night] I'll try to sleep, I promise.
[joke,eating] Don't make me laugh with my mouth full.

warm.li: [debate] Still friends, whatever we think.
[argue] I'm sorry it went like that.
[reminisce] I'm glad you were there for it.

blunt.li: [argue,working] Move, I've a job to finish.

cheerful.li: [debate] Rematch at supper, then.
[argue] Fine, I'll go and be right at the other end of the colony.
[reminisce,good] We should do something that daft again.

gloomy.li: [debate] We'll both have forgotten this by tomorrow, anyway.
[argue] Of course it ended like this.
[reminisce,bad] I wish you hadn't brought it up.

cold.li: [reminisce] It was a long time ago.

plain.li: [night] You're up late, can't you sleep either?
[eating] You've barely touched your food.
[afterraid] It's been a hard few days, hasn't it.
[grief,subject] I keep thinking about {SUBJECT} too.
[homesick] You've been looking down the road a lot lately.
[worry] You look like you've been carrying something around for days.
[shame] People forget faster than you think.

warm.li: Sit down here with me, I've saved you a spot.
[grief] I'm so sorry, love.
[lonely] I've been meaning to come and find you.
[fear] Come here, you're safe with me.
[despair] Talk to me, please, whatever it is.
[homesick] Tell me about home, I'd like to hear it.

blunt.li: [lonely] You've been hiding, and I've noticed.

cheerful.li: [lowmood] Shove over, I've come to cheer you up whether you like it or not.
[lonely] I'm bored, and you're my favorite person to be bored with.
[worry] Tell me your worries and I'll tell you mine, mine are sillier.
[despair] Right, it's you, me, and the worst joke I know.
[homesick] Teach me a song from back home.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Bad one today?
[grief] It's no good acting brave, is it.
[fear] I can't sleep either, if it helps.
[worry] I worry too, all the time.
[lonely] It's easy to feel alone here, I know.

cold.li: [lowmood] Your work's slipped, so something's wrong.
[grief] You're not eating, and you need to.
[fear] Being afraid made sense, but it's past now.
[worry] You're distracted, and I want to know why.

plain.li: [night] I keep lying awake.
[eating] I'm not hungry, that's all.
[grief,subject] Something happens and I think, I must tell {SUBJECT}.
[despair] I don't know what I'm for anymore.
[lonely] Everyone has someone, and I don't.
[fear] I jump at every shadow now.
[worry] I can't stop counting what could go wrong.
[shame] I keep going over what I should have done.
[homesick] It's the little things I miss, the sounds of the place.
[afterraid] I can still hear it, the fighting.

warm.li: Thank you for coming to find me.
[grief] It helps, you being here.
[lonely] I didn't know how much I needed someone to ask.
[fear] Will you stay a while?
[despair] I'll try, for you.
[homesick] You're kind to ask about it.

blunt.li: [shame] Don't, I know what I did.

cheerful.li: [lowmood] I'll be all right, I always bounce back eventually.
[despair] Well, you've made me smile, which is a start.
[lonely] Careful, I might follow you around now.
[fear] I'm only slightly terrified, most of the time.
[grief] They'd laugh at me moping like this.

gloomy.li: [despair] It won't get better, I know it won't.
[grief] There's a hole where they used to be.
[worry] It's going to go wrong, I can feel it.
[lonely] I'm always on my own in the end.
[fear] It'll come back, whatever it was.

cold.li: [shame] I made a mistake, and I'll carry it.
[homesick] Home's gone, there's no use thinking about it.

plain.li: [night] Try and get some sleep, I'll be close by.
[eating] Eat something, even a few mouthfuls, for me.
[afterraid] It's over now, and you're still here.
[grief,subject] {SUBJECT} would be glad you've got people around you.
[homesick] Tell me how they cooked it back home, and we'll try it here.
[shame] What's done is done, and you're still one of us.
[lonely] I'll knock on your door after supper.
[worry] Let me carry some of it for a while.

warm.li: I'm right here, whenever you need me.
[grief] Cry as much as you need, I'm not going anywhere.
[lonely] You won't be alone here, not while I'm around.
[fear] Hold my hand until it passes.
[despair] One day at a time, and I'll be there for each of them.
[homesick] We'll be your home, if you'll let us.

blunt.li: Go and rest, that's an order.
[grief] It's rotten, and it'll stay rotten for a while.
[fear] Nothing's getting in, I'll see to that.
[shame] Done is done, so move on.

cheerful.li: I'll come back later with something to make you laugh.
[grief] Some day soon we'll tell stories about them, the funny ones.
[lonely] You're helping me in the garden tomorrow, and you'll like it.
[worry] Worries shrink in daylight, you'll see.
[fear] Anything that comes for you has to get past me, and I'm very annoying.

gloomy.li: It won't feel like this forever, or so they tell me.
[grief] I'll miss them too, every day.
[despair] We'll keep going, because what else is there.
[lonely] Two lonely people make a pair, at least.
[fear] If it comes, it comes for both of us.

cold.li: Rest now, and we'll see how you are tomorrow.
[fear] The walls held last time, and they'll hold again.
[worry] Most of what you fear won't happen, and we'll deal with what does.
[shame] It's forgotten, if you let it be.
